ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across approximately 90% of the surface area with a high-intensity (white) localized region at the distal tip of the right lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-contrast white patch located on the distal-lateral margin of the right fluke lobe; diffuse grey-scale mottling clusters observed surrounding the median notch area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated trailing edge with distinct irregular peaks and valleys; highest serration frequency located on the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge sweeping symmetrically upward towards the distal tips.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry; right lobe tip displays a prominent white patch while the left lobe tip remains entirely dark.
